Question ID: ANP_U03_L02_GP_Q01
MLA Standard: MLA.ANP.SKM.01

Guided practice item 1.
Lesson focus: Axial and Appendicular Skeleton
Stimulus: Skeleton classification diagram

A student is reviewing the required visual and must explain the first visible structure-function connection. Which answer uses the lesson evidence most accurately?

generalfeedback.text: Teachable feedback: First, identify whether a bone belongs to body axis or limbs/girdles. Then use the required stimulus (Skeleton classification diagram) to connect the visible evidence to axial and appendicular skeletal organization. Correct reasoning stays inside MLA.ANP.SKM.01 and avoids the common mistake: classifying bones only by size.
